text: DeclareNonCommutative[a, b, ...] declares a,b, ... to be non-commutative, i.e., DataType[a,b, ..., NonCommutative] is set to True.
As a side effect of DeclareNonCommutative, x is declared to be of data type NonCommutative.
DeclareNonCommutative[y, z] DataType[a, x, y, z, NonCommutative]
UnDeclareNonCommutative[x, y, z] DataType[a, x, y, z, NonCommutative]
